name: tailorhub
description: TailorHub monorepo — frontend/ (TanStack Start) and backend/ (Express + TypeScript + PostgreSQL) as independent, sibling projects.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
